name: ALM4DataverseSetConnectionVariables
description: Sets ALM4DataverseSetConnectionVariables.* variables and optionally AZURE_* environment variables to provide custom script tasks access to use the Service Connection as a single source of truth. Supports WorkloadIdentityFederation and ManagedServiceIdentity with enhanced Azure DevOps compatibility and automatic Azure SDK integration.
author: ALM4Dataverse
helpMarkDown: Sets pipeline variables from Power Platform service connection. Supports WorkloadIdentityFederation, ManagedServiceIdentity, and Service Principal with client secret authentication. Can automatically configure Azure SDK environment variables for seamless DefaultAzureCredential integration with enhanced Azure DevOps compatibility.

outputVariables.name: EnvironmentUrl
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Environment URL used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: ApplicationId
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Application Id used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: TenantId
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Tenant Id used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: AuthenticationType
outputVariables.description: Output variable indicating the authentication type used (WorkloadIdentityFederation, ManagedServiceIdentity, or ClientSecret)

inputs.name: authenticationType
inputs.label: Authentication type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose the authentication method for connecting to Power Platform.

inputs.name: PowerPlatformSPN
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authenticate with your Power Platform environment with an Azure AppID, tenantID and client secret, WorkloadIdentityFederation, or ManagedServiceIdentity.
